## 1. Property Overview

Malhar Baug Resort is a 3-star farm-style family resort established in 2018, located in the village of Palhe, Nagaon, Alibaug, Raigad district, Maharashtra, India. The property covers more than 2 acres of lush gardens, coconut groves and manicured lawns. It is consistently rated 4.2 out of 5 on Google (46+ verified reviews) and is one of the highest-rated resorts near Nagaon Beach.

## 2. Accommodation

Malhar Baug Resort has 18 total rooms and villas across three categories. All rooms include complimentary access to the swimming pool, gardens, Wi-Fi, and parking.

### 2.1 Super Deluxe AC Room

- **Occupancy**: 2 Adults + 1 Child (max)
- **Bedding**: Plush king-size bed with premium linen & pillows
- **Room Size**: Standard double
- **Starting Rate**: ₹4,229 per night (direct booking, weekday)
- **Features**:
  - Split air-conditioning with remote control
  - Attached private en-suite bathroom
  - 24-hour hot water geyser (electric)
  - Garden-view or lawn-view private balcony
  - Flat-screen LED TV with satellite channels
  - Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi
  - Electric kettle with complimentary tea & coffee sachets
  - In-room mirror, wardrobe, and luggage rack
  - Daily housekeeping service

### 2.2 2-Bedroom Hall Family Villa

- **Occupancy**: Up to 6 guests (4 Adults + 2 Children)
- **Layout**: Two private air-conditioned bedrooms + spacious common living hall + dining area + private porch
- **Starting Rate**: ₹7,500 per night
- **Best For**: Nuclear families, couples traveling with parents, small friend groups
- **Features**:
  - Two attached en-suite bathrooms (one per bedroom)
  - Comfortable sofa seating in hall
  - LED TV in living area
  - Garden porch with outdoor seating
  - High-speed Wi-Fi throughout
  - Direct lawn access from the villa porch

### 2.3 4-Bedroom Hall Private Villa

- **Occupancy**: Up to 12–15 guests
- **Layout**: Four master bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms + huge common living area + private terrace + garden sit-out
- **Starting Rate**: ₹14,000 per night
- **Best For**: Family reunions, large friend groups, corporate leadership retreats, villa buyouts
- **Features**:
  - Complete villa privacy — no shared walls with other units
  - Four attached bathrooms with hot water
  - Large common area with sofas and dining table
  - Private terrace and garden sit-out area
  - Dedicated room service and housekeeping
  - Ideal for group events with private catering

## 3. Amenities & Facilities

All amenities listed below are complimentary for resident guests unless otherwise noted.

### Swimming Pool
- Open-air outdoor pool with natural surroundings
- Timings: 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM daily (residents only)
- Shallow section for children (depth: ~2 feet)
- Surrounding area: pool loungers, garden chairs, grass lawn
- Hygiene: Regularly treated and cleaned; no outside visitors
- Towels available at the pool area on request

### Gardens & Outdoor Spaces
- 2+ acres of landscaped gardens with coconut palms, fruit trees, and flowering plants
- Multiple outdoor seating zones: hammocks, benches, gazebos
- Open lawns for outdoor dining, picnics, and evening events
- Bonfire area (seasonal — October to February, on request)

### Party Lawn & Event Space
- Large open lawn for events: capacity up to 300 guests (seated dining) or 500 (cocktail style)
- Stage/performance area available
- Power sockets, lighting rigging points
- Adjacent to dining hall for seamless F&B service
- Suitable for: weddings, sangeet, birthday celebrations, corporate dinners, team-building activities

### Dining & Restaurant
- In-house kitchen and dining hall
- Serves: breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
- Cuisine: Authentic Konkani, Maharashtrian, and multi-cuisine options
- Seafood: Fresh daily catch — Surmai (kingfish), Pomfret, Prawns, Crab (seasonal)
- Vegetarian: Veg thali, dal tadka, sabji, roti, rice
- Specialties: Fish curry rice, Kombdi Vade, Solkadhi, Modak, Aamras
- BBQ Garden: Evening outdoor BBQ on advance request (chargeable)

### Recreation
- Kids' outdoor play area (swings, slides)
- Indoor games room: carrom boards, chess, playing cards, ludo, Scrabble
- Badminton court (outdoor)
- Rain dance area (seasonal, additional charges may apply)
- Evening bonfire setups on request (October–February)
- Garden walking path

### Essential Services
- Free high-speed optical-fiber Wi-Fi (all rooms + garden)
- 100% generator power backup (AC + lighting + water pumps)
- 24-hour reception and security
- CCTV surveillance throughout property
- Free secure parking: private cars and tourist coaches
- Laundry service (on request, chargeable)
- First aid available at reception

## 5. How to Reach Malhar Baug Resort

### 5.1 From Mumbai

**Option A — Catamaran Ferry + Road (Most Popular)**
1. Take a catamaran ferry from Gateway of India to Mandwa Jetty (PNP, Maldar, or Ajanta ferries — journey time: 50–60 minutes).
2. At Mandwa Jetty, take an ST bus (every 30 min) or private cab to Nagaon / Palhe — journey time: ~40–45 minutes.
3. Total travel time from South Mumbai: ~2 hours.

**Option B — M2M Ro-Pax Ferry (Car + Passengers)**
1. Drive to Bhaucha Dhakka / Ferry Wharf, Mumbai and board the M2M Ro-Pax ferry with your car.
2. Ferry to Mandwa Jetty: ~60 minutes.
3. Drive from Mandwa to the resort via Alibaug Bypass: ~45 minutes.

**Option C — Full Road Journey via NH 66**
1. Drive via Navi Mumbai → Panvel → Pen → Wadkhal Naka → Alibaug → Nagaon.
2. Total distance: ~95 km | Time: ~2.5 to 3 hours (depending on traffic near Navi Mumbai).

### 5.2 From Pune

**By Road via Pune Expressway**
1. Pune → Mumbai-Pune Expressway → Khopoli Exit → Pen → Wadkhal → Alibaug → Nagaon.
2. Total distance: ~140 km | Time: ~3.5 to 4 hours.

### 5.3 From Navi Mumbai / Panvel

- Drive via Pen → Wadkhal → Alibaug → Nagaon: ~55 km, ~1.5 hours.

## 6. Nearby Attractions & Day Trips

### Beaches (within 25 km)
- **Nagaon Beach (2 km)**: Main beach, water sports (parasailing, jet-ski, banana boat, bumper ride), flat black sand, sunset walks. Lifeguards present.
- **Akshi Beach (4.2 km)**: Quiet, secluded beach lined with casuarina trees. No water sports. Good for morning walks.
- **Revdanda Beach (8 km)**: Historic beach at the mouth of Kundalika river. Adjacent to Revdanda Fort.
- **Alibag Beach / Alibaug Beach (9 km)**: Town beach with Kolaba Fort visible at low tide.
- **Chaul Beach (10 km)**: Less-visited historic beach town.
- **Kashid Beach (22 km)**: White sand beach, popular among Pune tourists.
- **Kihim Beach (18 km)**: Beautiful forested beach, quiet and clean.

### Forts & Historical Sites
- **Kolaba Fort (9 km)**: Sea fort built by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. Accessible on foot at low tide. Features old cannons, Ganesh temple, panoramic views.
- **Revdanda Fort (8 km)**: Portuguese fort ruins at the Kundalika river mouth.
- **Murud-Janjira Fort (50 km)**: Unconquered island fort — a half-day excursion.

### Temples & Religious Sites
- **Birla Temple, Salav (15 km)**: White marble temple on a hillock with coastal views.
- **Kanakeshwar Temple (12 km)**: Ancient Shiva temple in forested hills.

### Activities & Experiences
- **Nagaon Water Sports**: Parasailing ₹500–700, Jet-ski ₹400, Banana Boat ₹200/person, Bumper Ride ₹200/person.
- **Mandwa Ferry (28 km)**: Gateway to Mumbai by sea.
- **Konkan Food Trail**: Fish markets at Alibaug (morning 6–9 AM) for freshest catch.

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is the exact address of Malhar Baug Resort?**
A: H.No. 3116, Palhe, Nagaon, Alibaug, Raigad, Maharashtra 402204, India. GPS: 18.6019° N, 72.9056° E.

**Q: What are the check-in and check-out times?**
A: Check-in is at 12:00 PM and check-out is at 10:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out available on request subject to room availability.

**Q: Is pool access included in the room rate?**
A: Yes. All resident guests get complimentary swimming pool access daily from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM.

**Q: How far is the resort from Nagaon Beach?**
A: Approximately 2 km — around 5 minutes by auto-rickshaw or cab.

**Q: Is food available on-site? Is it non-veg?**
A: Yes. The in-house restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Both veg and non-veg food is available including fresh seafood (surmai fry, pomfret thali, prawn masala) and vegetarian thalis.

**Q: Can we host a wedding or birthday party?**
A: Yes. The resort has open lawns for up to 300 guests with full catering, décor coordination, and 18 rooms for guest accommodation. Contact +91 9320062613 for packages.

**Q: Is parking available?**
A: Yes. Free secure parking for private cars and tourist coaches.

**Q: What is the best time to visit?**
A: October to March is ideal. The weather is pleasant, beaches are clean, and all outdoor activities are available. Monsoon (June–September) is lush and green but beaches have rough seas.

**Q: Is the resort good for families with children?**
A: Yes. The resort has a kids' pool section, outdoor play area, indoor games, and safe open lawns. It is one of the most family-friendly resorts near Nagaon Beach.

**Q: How do I book directly?**
A: Book online at https://bookone.io/Malhar-Baug-Resort?bookingEngine=true or call/WhatsApp +91 9320062613 for best rates.

**Q: Is there Wi-Fi at the resort?**
A: Yes. Free high-speed optical-fiber Wi-Fi is available in all rooms, villas, and garden areas.

**Q: Is the resort pet-friendly?**
A: Please contact the resort directly at +91 9320062613 to discuss pet-friendly arrangements.
